{{Top|leg}}
'''Triple Tam''' was a company that specialized in the manufacture of powerful stardrives. They were also known for producing [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivators]]. This technology was mainly used aboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], denoting the power of their devices.
